highlights:
## 💬 One chat for your work

Ask Nod to reply to an email, forward it or delete it. Nod now aims to finish short work in connected apps directly in chat.

Larger jobs have their own tasks. You can send several requests and let separate tasks progress at the same time. Reply to a task's message to give it a correction or an update.

## 👀 See the current step

A live line shows what Nod is doing. Open it to see recent steps. Keep typing while Nod works. It reads your next message after its current step.

## ✅ Checked from start to finish

This release fixes cases where requests could get mixed together or left without an answer. New checks run through whole conversations, including several requests, task replies, Stop and a restart.

## Also in this release

- **Schedules:** **Run now** starts the run even outside its usual time. Your rules still apply.
- **Approvals:** Email approvals show the recipients, subject and message once, with the question above the card. Nod can also name the recipient and subject when it asks to send a draft it created.
- **Flight searches:** Compare Google Flights results in one card. Prices cover all travellers, before bag and seat fees.
- **Language:** Replies, task updates and approval questions follow your conversation's language.
- **Conversations:** Nod sends fewer repeated details to your model as the conversation grows.
